title: Squash Analyzer
shortDescription: Score squash as a coach or referee, with your team in one app.
fullDescription:
Squash Analyzer helps coaches and referees keep track of squash matches, point by point. Free and without ads. An account is never required, but makes things a lot easier with your team.

YOUR TEAM AND YOUR ACCOUNT (NEW IN 4.0)
• When someone in your team starts a team match, it appears in your app by itself and the team score on your lock screen
• A notification when a match of your team starts and when it is decided
• When a teammate, coach or referee records your match, it arrives in your app by itself; you choose whether it counts
• As a bonus those matches count for your badges, also on a new phone, and your photo shows with you in your teammates' app
• Create an account with your email address, from age 16; you can always delete it in the app

REFEREE
• Tap the score to award a rally
• LET, STROKE and undo, also after resuming a match
• Service side left/right and a timeline with every rally
• Match and game timers, and after every game the result with duration and rallies
• Matches are saved automatically and can be resumed
• Best of 1, 3 or 5, and edit the names during the match

COACH
• Record for every point who scored, how (winner, pressure, error or service point), from which zone and with which shot
• For an unforced error also the kind: down, out, service or floor
• START GAME at the first service, so the warm-up does not count
• Court in 6 or 9 zones, and a switch for volleys
• Analysis per game: heatmap, shots, point breakdown and tactical advice

PLAYERS AND BADGES
• Save your players with a photo and focus points; import a whole team with one link
• Players earn 39 badges, such as 5 points in a row or a game won 11-0; eighteen of them in bronze, silver and gold, including the new Team player and Match winner for the league
• Share a player's badge card as a picture with a link; it opens in the app (Android and iPhone) or in the browser

MY TEAM
• Playing in the Dutch SBN league via sbn.toernooi.nl? See your team's standings and schedule on the home screen
• Keep team matches with your team, followed live by supporters and on your lock screen

LIVE SHARING
• Share a link and let your team follow the score live in the browser, with player photos (can be turned off)

SHARING AND BACKUP
• Share the score as a scorecard, report or picture, for example in WhatsApp
• Back up to a folder of your choice, also automatically

PRIVACY
• An account is never required; without one everything works as before
• Players and matches stay on your device; only live sharing, an account or a question to the manual sends data to our server (see the privacy policy)
• No ads, no tracking

Manual: https://squashanalyzer.com/en/guide/android.html
